notes: Not standard RNA-seq: aggresome RNA is an anti-GFP immunoprecipitate (IP_or_pulldown); 'cytosol RNA' is the non-aggresome fraction after high-speed centrifugation (subcellular fraction, assay_class other). All samples arsenite-treated, so no control. Arsenite labelled metal_excess (metalloid). HslU-GFP fusion = tagged strain, reference. One aggresome sample without rRNA removal (rrna_removal none).

growth_phase.q: exponential growth phase, 2 mM NaAsO2 for 30 mins

treatment.q: exponential growth phase, 2 mM NaAsO2 for 30 mins

inducer_added.q: MG1655 bacterial cultures expressing HslU-GFP in exponential phase were treated with 2 mM NaAsO2 for 30 mins

transcription_arrested.q: MG1655 bacterial cultures expressing HslU-GFP in exponential phase were treated with 2 mM NaAsO2 for 30 mins

assay_class.q: we used anti-GFP antibody (MBL, M048-3, Lot:065) and Protein A Dynabeads to enrich aggresome
